item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera records the maximum and minimum air temperatures at her home in Jaipur every day for one week in March, using a maximum-minimum thermometer. Her brother says, "The maximum and minimum temperatures must be exactly the same on every day of the week."
Which statement about her records is correct?

options.A: The maximum and minimum temperatures are always the same every day, because the same thermometer is used.
options.B: The maximum and minimum temperatures usually vary from day to day, because weather conditions change.
options.C: The maximum temperature must rise and the minimum temperature must fall every single day.
options.D: The maximum and minimum temperatures never change during the year, whatever the season.
